items.quote: And the LORD said unto Moses
Speak unto the priests the sons of Aaron, and say unto them
items.claim: Moses was instructed to speak unto the priests of Aaron
items.object: the priests the sons of Aaron

items.quote: There shall none be defiled for the dead among his people
items.claim: The priests shall not be defiled for the dead among his people

items.quote: But for his kin, that is near unto him, that is, for his mother, and for his father, and for his son, and for his daughter, and for his brother.
items.claim: Priests may be defiled for their close relatives
